skill.summary: Get ready-to-share videos ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your text prompt (TXT, DOCX, PDF, copied text, up to 500MB), say something...

latestVersion.changelog:
Text to Video Gratis 1.0.0 — initial release:

- Instantly convert any text (TXT, DOCX, PDF, or pasted) into ready-to-share videos with music and visuals, no editing skills required.
- Simple upload and prompt system—describe what you want, and receive a 1080p MP4 within minutes.
- All video generation and rendering is done server-side on GPU nodes.
- Up to 500MB file uploads supported; files and text processed rapidly for quick turnaround.
- Built-in error handling, free starter tokens, and clear feedback/status messages throughout workflow.
- Designed for creators, marketers, students—no software to install or complex timeline editing needed.
